title: Services · Muse
description: Current Muse operations: availability, playback HTTP activity, acquisition, library snapshots, search diagnostics and MusicBrainz. Snapshot panels require fresh scrapes; absent data is never shown as healthy.

options.content: Grey / Unknown means missing or stale evidence. Chart gaps can mean no observations. HTTP timings measure server responses, not when audio becomes audible.

panels.title: Service checks
panels.description: Public reachability, the direct application/SQLite health endpoint, and the Muse metric scrape. Missing results remain unknown.

targets.expr: ((label_replace(((probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="edge"} and on(instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1)) and (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="edge"}) < 90)), "measure", "edge", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "edge", "__name__", ".*")) or ((label_replace(((probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="core",check="health"} and on(instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1)) and (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="core",check="health"}) < 90)), "measure", "core", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "core", "__name__", ".*")) or ((label_replace(((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90))), "measure", "metrics", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "metrics", "__name__", ".*"))

panels.title: Library and acquisition
panels.description: Library database entries, refreshed by the 30-second health probe, capped at 100,000; this does not verify files on disk. Workers excludes queued/recently completed jobs and separate CLI processes.

targets.expr: ((label_replace((((muse_library_tracks{job="muse"}) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp(muse_library_tracks{job="muse"}) < 90)) and on(host) (max by(host) ((probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="core",check="health"} and on(instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1)) and (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="core",check="health"}) < 90)) == 1)), "measure", "Library entries", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "Library entries", "__name__", ".*")) or ((label_replace(((muse_jobs_active{job="muse"}) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp(muse_jobs_active{job="muse"}) < 90)), "measure", "Active acquisition workers", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "Active acquisition workers", "__name__", ".*"))

panels.title: Playback preparation requests/min
panels.description: HTTP requests, not listening sessions or playback starts. Background queue preparation is included.

targets.expr: sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/playback"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60
sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/queue/prepare"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60
sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/prepared"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60

panels.title: Playback preparation response latency
panels.description: Rolling 30-minute p95 of handler response time, including cache hits. This excludes full media transfer and time until audio starts. Idle windows have no latency sample; the histogram's highest finite bucket is 60 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/playback"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/playback"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route="/api/queue/prepare"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/queue/prepare"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/prepared"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/prepared"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Media requests/min
panels.description: Manifest, media segment and file requests are different operations; these counts do not represent playback starts.

targets.expr: sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/hls.m3u8"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60
sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/hls/{name}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60
sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/file"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60

panels.title: Media handler response latency
panels.description: Rolling 30-minute p95 of handler response time, including cache hits. This excludes full media transfer and time until audio starts. Idle windows have no latency sample; the histogram's highest finite bucket is 60 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/hls.m3u8"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/hls.m3u8"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/hls/{name}"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/hls/{name}"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/file"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route="/api/track/{mbid}/file"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Acquisition outcomes since restart
panels.description: Outcomes recorded by this server process since it started. Separate CLI runs and exceptions before outcome recording are not included; missing categories do not imply zero failures.

targets.expr: (muse_fetch_total{job="muse"}) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp(muse_fetch_total{job="muse"}) < 90)

panels.title: Acquisition duration
panels.description: Rolling one-hour estimates for instrumented fetch durations. Highest finite bucket: 180 seconds; no observations means no latency sample.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le,source) ((rate(muse_fetch_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(source) (sum by(source) ((rate(muse_fetch_seconds_count{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,source) ((rate(muse_fetch_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(source) (sum by(source) ((rate(muse_fetch_seconds_count{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Active acquisition workers
panels.description: In-process running workers only; queued and recently completed jobs are excluded.

targets.expr: (muse_jobs_active{job="muse"}) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp(muse_jobs_active{job="muse"}) < 90)

panels.title: Library database entries
panels.description: Refreshed by /api/health every 30 seconds, up to 100,000 rows. This is a database-entry count, not a filesystem-integrity check.

targets.expr: ((muse_library_tracks{job="muse"}) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp(muse_library_tracks{job="muse"}) < 90)) and on(host) (max by(host) ((probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="core",check="health"} and on(instance) (up{job="blackbox"} == 1)) and (time() - timestamp(probe_success{job="blackbox",service="muse",layer="core",check="health"}) < 90)) == 1)

panels.title: Search HTTP requests/min
panels.description: Includes cached/coalesced responses and local-library searches. No series exists until that route has been used in this process.

targets.expr: sum by(route) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route=~"/api/search.*"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60

panels.title: Search HTTP response latency
panels.description: Rolling 30-minute p95 of handler response time, including cache hits. This excludes full media transfer and time until audio starts. Idle windows have no latency sample; the histogram's highest finite bucket is 60 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le,route) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route=~"/api/search.*"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(route) (sum by(route) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route=~"/api/search.*"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,route) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_bucket{job="muse",route=~"/api/search.*"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(route) (sum by(route) ((rate(muse_http_seconds_count{job="muse",route=~"/api/search.*"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Completed search pipeline latency
panels.description: Completed pipeline executions, including background prefetch. Cached/shared calls, early returns and local-library search bypass this instrumentation. Highest finite bucket: 10 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_search_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_search_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_search_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_search_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Search stage p95
panels.description: Rolling 30-minute p95 by measured pipeline stage. Missing samples may mean that path was not exercised; highest finite bucket: 10 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,stage) ((rate(muse_search_stage_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(stage) (sum by(stage) ((rate(muse_search_stage_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Mean search stage latency
panels.description: Measured stage seconds divided by observed stage completions. This is latency per observation, not seconds of work per elapsed second.

targets.expr: (sum by(stage) ((rate(muse_search_stage_seconds_sum{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) / sum by(stage) ((rate(muse_search_stage_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(stage) (sum by(stage) ((rate(muse_search_stage_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Search pipeline completions/min
panels.description: Completed pipeline executions by detected intent, including prefetch. This is not the total HTTP search request count.

targets.expr: sum by(intent) ((rate(muse_search_total{job="muse"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 60

panels.title: MusicBrainz data age
panels.description: Queried from the mirror on each metric scrape. A long full-rebuild age alone does not prove an unhealthy mirror; replication age and query performance are separate signals. Failed lookups emit no value.

targets.expr: ((label_replace((((muse_mb_replication_lag_seconds{job="muse"} >= 0)) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp((muse_mb_replication_lag_seconds{job="muse"} >= 0)) < 90)), "measure", "Latest replication packet age", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "Latest replication packet age", "__name__", ".*")) or ((label_replace((((muse_mb_index_age_seconds{job="muse"} >= 0)) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp((muse_mb_index_age_seconds{job="muse"} >= 0)) < 90)), "measure", "Lookup tables: rebuild age", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "Lookup tables: rebuild age", "__name__", ".*"))

panels.title: MusicBrainz query latency
panels.description: Rolling 30-minute p95 by query category. Timings do not encode query success; highest finite bucket: 10 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,query) ((rate(muse_pg_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(query) (sum by(query) ((rate(muse_pg_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Provider request latency
panels.description: Observed rolling 30-minute p95 from Muse's own calls, not independent provider availability checks. No status-code labels are recorded; highest finite bucket: 180 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,endpoint) ((rate(muse_listenbrainz_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(endpoint) (sum by(endpoint) ((rate(muse_listenbrainz_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) ((rate(muse_slskd_search_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_slskd_search_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,op) ((rate(muse_ytm_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(op) (sum by(op) ((rate(muse_ytm_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Soulseek audio results per search
panels.description: Rolling one-hour mean usable audio results per observed Soulseek search. Zero is a measured empty result; absence means no observation.

targets.expr: (sum ((rate(muse_slskd_search_files_sum{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) / sum ((rate(muse_slskd_search_files_count{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on() (sum ((rate(muse_slskd_search_files_count{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Application CPU
panels.description: 100% equals one CPU core. External ffmpeg children and other processes are not included.

targets.expr: sum ((rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="muse"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 100

panels.title: Application memory
panels.description: Memory resident in the Muse process, excluding ffmpeg children and other services.

targets.expr: (process_resident_memory_bytes{job="muse"}) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp(process_resident_memory_bytes{job="muse"}) < 90)

panels.title: Runtime freshness
panels.description: Process uptime and age of the latest successful metric scrape. Unavailable or stale scrapes remain unknown.

targets.expr: ((label_replace((((time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="muse"})) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1) and (time() - timestamp((time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="muse"})) < 90)), "measure", "Process uptime", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "Process uptime", "__name__", ".*")) or ((label_replace(((time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"})) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)), "measure", "Last metric scrape", "job", ".*")) or on(measure) label_replace(vector(0/0), "measure", "Last metric scrape", "__name__", ".*"))

panels.title: Active alert rules
panels.description: Pending/firing rules affecting Muse or its host/ingress. Inhibited alerts remain visible; firing is not proof a notification was sent.

targets.expr: ALERTS{alertstate=~"pending|firing",service="muse"} or ALERTS{alertstate=~"pending|firing",host="media-server",service=~"host|storage|host-resources|node-exporter"} or ALERTS{alertstate=~"pending|firing",host="rpi5",service=~"nginx|host|blackbox-exporter|prometheus"}

panels.title: Progressive stream first byte
panels.description: Only progressive /stream and Subsonic paths record this measurement. It does not measure HLS/file playback startup. Idle windows are blank; highest finite bucket: 10 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le,source) ((rate(muse_stream_first_byte_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(source) (sum by(source) ((rate(muse_stream_first_byte_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,source) ((rate(muse_stream_first_byte_seconds_bucket{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1)))) and on(source) (sum by(source) ((rate(muse_stream_first_byte_seconds_count{job="muse"}[30m]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) > 0)

panels.title: Progressive stream outcomes/hour
panels.description: Recorded source selections for progressive /stream and Subsonic requests, including source=none when all sources fail. These are not successful audio plays and exclude modern HLS/file playback.

targets.expr: sum by(source) ((rate(muse_stream_total{job="muse"}[1h]) and on(instance) ((up{job="muse"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="muse"}) < 90)) == 1))) * 3600
